design_principle: Every proposal is an exact false-to-true onset of an environment AND setup AND confirmation state. Definitions were selected using feature-only density and overlap diagnostics. Labels, R, win rate and candidate performance were not read.

C001.name: H1_TREND_PULLBACK_RESUMPTION
C001.environment: Directional H1 EMA20/50 trend, non-opposing H1 EMA50/200 structure, H1 ADX >= 0.16 and H4 EMA20/50 not strongly opposing.
C001.setup: Previous exact M15 RSI is beyond +/-0.10 against the trend.
C001.confirmation: M15 RSI crosses zero in trend direction, MACD histogram improves, signed body and close location confirm direction.

C002.name: MULTIBAR_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT
C002.environment: Previous exact one- and two-bar M15 ATR percentiles show compression.
C002.setup: Previous exact close remains on the non-breakout side of the Bollinger band.
C002.confirmation: Current band breakout, prior-20 extreme break, body fraction >= 0.55, volume ratio >= 1.15, H1 slope aligned and H1 ADX >= 0.15.

C003.name: FAILED_BREAKOUT_RECLAIM
C003.setup: Previous exact M15 close is beyond the prior 20-bar extreme by at least 0.05 ATR.
C003.confirmation: Current close reclaims the extreme with directional wick, close location, signed body and RSI improvement.

C004.name: ROLLING_EXTREME_RETEST_CONTINUATION
C004.environment: H1 and H4 EMA20/50 direction aligned with H1 ADX >= 0.12.
C004.setup: Previous exact M15 close is at or near the prior 50-bar directional extreme.
C004.confirmation: Current bar remains within 0.50 ATR of the extreme and shows directional wick, close location and non-opposing body.

C005.name: HIGH_VOL_EXHAUSTION_TURN
C005.environment: M15 ATR percentile >= 0.60 and range >= 0.80 ATR.
C005.confirmation: Directional exhaustion wick, close recovery, MACD histogram turn and body not strongly opposing.
